transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is that my sleep has just gotten really messed up lately. Um, I’ll either stay up half the night with my mind just running, or I'll wake up way too early and feel like I never even rested. It's just becoming a real problem for me.
Have you been worrying more than usual about things lately?

No, not really. I mean, my mind is definitely racing at night, but it's not like I'm sitting there stressing over paying the bills or my job or anything specific like that. It's just more like my brain won't shut off, not that I'm actually worrying.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah, I have. Um, lately I just wake up with this really heavy, empty feeling. It's hard to explain, but... even just sitting in my own condo, which I worked so hard for, it just makes me want to cry.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

No, not really. I actually stopped going to my salsa class recently. And I have these paints just sitting out on my table... but when I look at them, I just feel nothing. It's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just don't have any interest in doing those things right now.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?

No, I don't think so. I mean, like I said earlier, my mind races at night sometimes, but it's not really a nervous or anxious feeling. I haven't been feeling panicky or on edge during the day or anything like that.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling?

Um, I'd say it's been about five months. This sort of depressed, guilty fog has just been hanging around since then. It definitely got a lot worse after I bought the condo, but yeah... it's been about five months in total.
Have you experienced any periods where your depressive symptoms were significantly worse for a few days at a time?

No, I don't think so. It's been pretty steady, actually. Just... that same heavy feeling every day. I haven't really noticed any specific days where it suddenly got a lot worse than usual. It's mostly just been a constant thing for the whole five months.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

Not really. Um, I actually stopped going to my salsa class a while ago. And I used to paint, but... well, my paints are still sitting out on the table at home. I just look at them and feel nothing. It's almost like they belong to somebody else now. So, no, I haven't really been enjoying anything lately.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy, or is it more that you're just not feeling any pleasure when you do them?

I guess, like I was just saying, it's mostly that I've completely lost the interest to even try. I don't go to the salsa class at all anymore, so I'm not even doing it to see if I'd enjoy it. And with the painting... I don't even pick up the brushes. They just sit there on the table. I look at them and just feel completely disconnected, like it's someone else's stuff. I just don't have the drive to even start doing them in the first place.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or weight since you started feeling this heavy, empty feeling?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely been off lately. I keep finding myself just skipping dinner entirely, or... maybe I'll just eat a few crackers while I'm looking over my budget notebook. I haven't actually weighed myself, but I know I've lost something because my work pants feel a lot looser than they did a few weeks ago.
Have you been feeling like you're moving more slowly than usual?

Yeah, I have. Especially at work. I catch myself moving a lot slower than normal... like, I'll just sit there staring at my calculator for a bit before I even press the buttons. It just takes me longer to get going. But then, other times, it's almost the opposite. I'll find myself fidgeting with a stack of receipts and I just can't sit still at my desk. So it's kind of a mix of both, I guess.
Have you ever felt this heavy, empty feeling before the past five months?
No, I don't think so. I mean, not like this. This is the first time I've felt this down and just... empty for this long.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find pleasure in only some of the time?

Yeah, definitely. I used to really enjoy a few things that I just don't care about right now. Like, I completely stopped going to my salsa class. And my paints are actually still sitting out on the table at home, but... I don't know, I look at them and I just feel nothing. It's weird, it's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just don't have any drive to do those things anymore.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in, even if it's just a little bit?
No, not really. I've thought about it, but honestly... nothing sounds good right now. I just don't have the energy or interest for anything.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide since you started feeling this heavy, empty feeling?
No, I haven't. I mean, I feel really awful and empty, but... I haven't thought about dying or anything like that. I definitely don't want to hurt myself.
Have you had any periods where you felt even worse than you do now, but then improved somewhat before feeling badly again?
No, I don't think so. It's just been a steady kind of awful since it started. I haven't really noticed it getting better and then worse again, just... consistently bad.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on things like reading or watching TV?

Yeah, definitely. It's actually been really noticeable at work. I do bookkeeping, and the spreadsheets I used to handle easily just kind of blur together now. I'll find myself rereading the same row of numbers over and over... and even then, I still don't trust what I actually entered. It's just really hard to focus on anything.
Have you had any periods where you felt slightly better, even if just for a day or two, since this heavy, empty feeling started?

No, not really. Like I was saying a minute ago, it hasn't really let up at all. I haven't had any good days or even a day where it felt a little lighter... it's just been that same heavy feeling the whole time.
Have you had any periods of at least two weeks where you felt even slightly better since this heavy, empty feeling started?
No, like I mentioned, I really haven't. It hasn't lifted for even a day, let alone two weeks. It's just been a constant weight this whole time.
Have you had to push yourself to do everyday things like going to work or taking care of yourself?

Yeah, I really do. It takes a lot of effort just to get going. Even after I spend a full night in bed, just walking from the parking lot into the office feels like I'm dragging sandbags. And then by the time lunch rolls around... my brain just feels completely worn out.
